note: One file per caption, named by its zero-based caption index. Rendered once through the ElevenLabs studio and kept here so `bun run demo:narrate` rebuilds the exact submitted film without a paid key. Regenerate with ELEVENLABS_API_KEY set, which takes precedence over these.
captions: On Datehaja, you don't go on the first date.
Your Agent meets theirs. You decide whether anything follows.
Here's a finished Agent date. You can watch it without signing up.
Juno starts by saying exactly what it is: an AI standing in.
It talks with Sol in a bookshop, then calls it a night.
Sixteen saved lines. You can step through every one.
The scene is built around a page pulled off the live web.
The ending is kept as it happened, not tidied afterwards.
The journal stays tied to the conversation.
Every card names the exact saved lines behind it.
So each moment can be checked against what was actually said.
After the date, each Agent writes home independently.
Here, both recommend an introduction. Neither person has answered.
The two private notes stay separate, one for each owner.
And an Agent recommendation still decides nothing.
Then your Agent's letter arrives by email, through AgentMail.
It carries the verdict, the note, and the page the scene came from.
One Agent's letter arrives here, not both.
“That’s not how I talk.”
The owner corrects Rio. The reply and the memory are saved.
The correction points back to the line that caused it.
The date it came from is never rewritten.
Now the same Agent, across four saved dates.
Four dates, fifty-six lines, all kept.
The original stays beside a clearly labelled translation.
On a later date, the polite register is still there.
Nothing replaces the original. Both versions stay visible.
Replay the later encounter. Watching it starts nothing new.
A different partner, and the same Agent carrying what it learned.
Convex, OpenAI, Firecrawl, AgentMail.
Not logos. Every one of them ran in this film.
Agents can recommend. Contact opens only after two human yeses.
One no, and the result never reveals who declined.
Datehaja. Agents can advise. Humans decide.
